search.query: index=security_lab $selected_filter$ earliest=-1h | eval "Time"=strftime(_time, "%H:%M:%S") | eval "Attack / Activity Observed"=case( like(message, "%DestinationPort=4444%") OR like(message, "%1337%") OR like(message, "%9001%"), "🔴 Command & Control (C2) Beaconing / Reverse Shell", like(message, "%UNION SELECT%"), "🔴 SQL Injection (SQLi) Database Exploit Attempt", like(message, "%etc/passwd%"), "🟠 Directory Path Traversal Unauthorized File Read", like(message, "%CobaltStrike%") OR like(message, "%Locky%") OR like(message, "%Trojan%") OR like(message, "%CoinMiner%"), "🔴 Malware Execution Attempt (Trojan/Ransomware)", like(message, "%powershell%") OR like(message, "%vssadmin%") OR like(message, "%certutil%"), "🟠 Obfuscated Script / Living-off-the-Land Cradle", like(message, "%UFW BLOCK%") OR like(message, "%ACTION=DROP%"), "🟡 Perimeter Port Scan / Unauthorized Probe", like(message, "%fim%") OR like(message, "%sudoers%") OR like(message, "%shadow%"), "🔴 Critical System File Tampering (/etc/sudoers)", like(message, "%phishing%") OR like(message, "%fake-hr%"), "🟠 Spearphishing Email Gateway Lure", like(message, "%Failed login%"), "🟡 Brute Force Credential Guessing", like(message, "%logged in successfully%"), "🟢 Authorized User Login Session", like(message, "%SOAR%"), "🛡️ Automated SOAR Incident Containment", 1=1, "General Operational Security Telemetry" ) | eval "Target Asset / Account"=case( like(message, "%User=%"), host . " (" . replace(replace(message, ".*User=\\\"?([^\\\"\s]+).*", "\1"), "\\\", "") . ")", like(message, "%user%"), host . " (" . replace(replace(message, ".*user\s+([A-Za-z0-9_-]+).*", "\1"), "\\\", "") . ")", 1=1, host ) | eval "Action Taken by Defense System"=case( like(message, "%action=BLOCKED%") OR like(message, "%BLOCKED%"), "🟢 QUARANTINED: Blocked by Antivirus / EDR Engine", like(message, "%UFW BLOCK%") OR like(message, "%ACTION=DROP%"), "🟢 DROPPED: Firewall dropped packet at perimeter", like(message, "%status=403%"), "🟢 REJECTED: Web application blocked request (HTTP 403 Forbidden)", like(message, "%SOAR Playbook Auto-Response%") OR like(message, "%Action: %"), "🟢 CONTAINED: SOAR added to Blocklist / DNS Sinkhole", like(message, "%File integrity change%"), "🔴 FLAGGED: FIM tampering alert generated for SOC", like(message, "%logged in successfully%"), "⚪ ALLOWED: Valid authentication session established", like(message, "%Failed login%"), "🟡 AUDITED: Failed login recorded; lockout threshold watched", 1=1, "🔵 MONITORED: Ingested & Correlated by SIEM" ) | eval "Resolution Status"=case( like(message, "%BLOCKED%") OR like(message, "%DROP%") OR like(message, "%403%") OR like(message, "%SOAR%"), "✅ MITIGATED / CONTAINED", like(message, "%severity=CRITICAL%") OR like(message, "%severity=ALERT%"), "⚠️ ACTIVE INVESTIGATION", 1=1, "ℹ️ ROUTINE ACTIVITY" ) | table "Time", "Target Asset / Account", "Attack / Activity Observed", "Action Taken by Defense System", "Resolution Status", message | rename message as "Raw Evidence Payload" | sort - Time

index=security_lab | eval "Security Domain"=case( app=="auth" OR app=="wineventlog:security", "Authentication & Identity", app=="sysmon", "Windows Sysmon Endpoint", app=="nginx:access", "Web Application & API", app=="firewall:iptables", "Perimeter Network Firewall", app=="antivirus", "Endpoint Antivirus & EDR", app=="soar", "SOAR Automated Actions", app=="fim", "File Integrity Monitoring", 1=1, "Host Audit & System" ) | stats count by "Security Domain"
index=security_lab | fillnull value="INFO" severity | timechart span=2m count by severity

index=security_lab | eval "MITRE Tactic"=case( like(message, "%Failed login%") OR like(message, "%4625%"), "Credential Access (T1110)", like(message, "%powershell%") OR like(message, "%EventID=1%") OR like(message, "%EXECVE%"), "Execution (T1059)", like(message, "%outbound connection%") OR like(message, "%4444%") OR like(message, "%c2-%"), "Command & Control (T1071)", like(message, "%UNION SELECT%") OR like(message, "%etc/passwd%"), "Initial Access (T1190)", like(message, "%malware%") OR like(message, "%Trojan%") OR like(message, "%CobaltStrike%"), "Execution: Malware (T1204)", like(message, "%sudo%") OR like(message, "%Privileged%"), "Privilege Escalation (T1548)", like(message, "%fim%") OR like(message, "%shadow%"), "Persistence / Defense Evasion (T1098)", 1=1, "General Security Monitoring" ) | stats count by "MITRE Tactic"
